about_subtitle: Our e-commerce adventure, which started in 2021, continues with increasing variety and prioritizing customer satisfaction.
about_story_p1: Beyond classic varieties of dried fruits and nuts, we set out to bring regional flavours to customers living abroad. We are delighted to deliver the freshest, highest-quality products to our valued customers at the fairest price and as quickly as possible.
about_story_p2: The hardships faced by Turkish farmers and producers, and their struggle to be paid fairly for their work, have been voiced for years. We take responsibility in this area too: we aim to work directly with producers, buy straight from farmers and help them obtain international certifications (BIO, FairTrade, etc.).
about_value1_desc: We choose our products with freshness and quality first, and get them to you quickly at a fair price.
about_value2_desc: Part of the products in our shop is bought directly from the producer, and raising that share is one of our key goals.
about_value3_desc: We aim to improve producers' quality of life while helping our customers consume more consciously.
about_value4_desc: Aware of our responsibility to future generations, we distribute our products with an environmentally friendly vehicle.
about_award_desc: The Bizimkiler project was awarded the special jury prize in 2020 in the SINGA Entrepreneurship programme for the sensitivities and goals above. Our finest reward is the smile on the faces of the customers who enjoy our products.
